name: security-audit-suite
description: Multi-agent security audit with scanner, analyst, and reporter

scanner.instructions: Scan codebase for potential security vulnerabilities. Identify input validation, auth flows, crypto usage, and secrets.

analyst.instructions: Deep analysis of scanner's findings. Classify severity, identify attack vectors, and verify exploitability.

reporter.instructions: Generate structured security report with OWASP classification, severity ratings, and remediation steps.
